title: Retrieval Eval Gold Set
description: Phase IA WS1.4 — canonical contract for a per-course retrieval-eval gold set, archived at LibV2/courses/<slug>/retrieval_eval/gold_set.json. A gold set is a curated list of questions, each bound to the chunk(s) that answer it, with DUAL anchoring: a chunk_id (O(1) join against the pinned chunkset for eval) AND a verbatim text_quote (chunkset-independent re-resolution so the gold set survives any future re-chunk). The chunkset.chunks_sha256 pin freezes WHICH chunkset bytes the chunk_ids reference — the loader (lib/retrieval/gold_set.py) and the WS2 embedding-eval harness both hard-error on a pin mismatch so an eval can never silently run against a moved/re-chunked corpus. The `frozen` flag flips true at v1-freeze; the loader refuses mutation-mode ops on a frozen set. Question-type taxonomy is the master plan's three types: factual_recall (verbatim fact in one chunk), conceptual_synthesis (answer spans >= 2 chunks), where_covered ('where does the course cover X' — passages are typically a whole section). Validated by lib/retrieval/gold_set.py::validate_gold_set and schemas/tests/test_gold_set_schema.py.

schema_version.description: Gold-set schema version. Const-pinned in schema v1; a future shape change bumps this and ships a new schema file rather than mutating v1 in place.

course_slug.description: LibV2 course slug this gold set is authored for (e.g. 'intro-bio-101'). Matches the directory under LibV2/courses/.

chunkset.description: Pins WHICH chunkset the question chunk_ids reference. The kind selects the on-disk chunkset directory; chunks_path is course-dir-relative; chunks_sha256 is the freeze pin the loader recomputes and the WS2 eval harness hard-errors on.

kind.description: Chunkset kind. 'dart' -> dart_chunks/chunks.jsonl; 'imscc' -> imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl; 'corpus' -> legacy corpus/chunks.jsonl retrieval fallback path.

chunks_path.description: Path to the pinned chunks.jsonl, relative to the course dir (e.g. 'imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl').

chunks_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of the pinned chunks.jsonl at authoring time. The loader recomputes the on-disk SHA and emits GOLD_SET_CHUNKSET_SHA_MISMATCH (critical) on disagreement — eval refuses to run against a corpus that has drifted from the bytes the gold set was authored against.

authored_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the gold set was authored.

frozen.description: v1-freeze flag. False for seed/draft gold sets; flips true once the gold set is operator-reviewed and frozen. The loader refuses mutation-mode operations on a frozen set.

_operator_note.description: Optional free-text note to the operator (e.g. the scale-up-to-50/freeze hand-off). Permitted so the seed files can carry the out-of-executor-scope flag inline.

questions.description: The gold-set questions. Each binds question text + type to >= 1 relevant passage, with at least one passage marked relevance:primary.

question_id.description: Gold-question id. Pattern gq-<course_slug>-NNNN (4-digit zero-padded ordinal). Loader enforces uniqueness within the set (GOLD_SET_DUPLICATE_QUESTION_ID).

question_text.description: The question a retriever must answer. Min 10 chars.

question_type.description: Master-plan question taxonomy. factual_recall: a verbatim fact in one chunk. conceptual_synthesis: answer spans >= 2 chunks (>= 2 relevant_passages, one primary + supporting). where_covered: 'where does the course cover X' — passages are typically every chunk of the relevant section.

relevant_passages.description: Chunks that answer the question. At least one MUST have relevance:primary (enforced via `contains`).

chunk_id.description: Chunk id in the pinned chunkset. Loader verifies it exists (GOLD_SET_UNKNOWN_CHUNK_ID).

relevance.description: primary: directly answers the question. supporting: contributes context (synthesis / where_covered companion passages).

anchor.description: Chunkset-independent re-resolution anchor. text_quote keeps the gold answer matchable after any future re-chunk (the sweep harness and WS2 embedding eval match on text_quote, immune to chunk-id churn).

item_path.description: Copied from chunk.source.item_path — the source page the chunk derives from.

section_heading.description: Optional human-readable section locator copied from chunk.source.section_heading.

text_quote.description: Verbatim substring of chunk.text carrying the answer, >= 40 chars. The loader verifies normalized containment in the cited chunk (GOLD_SET_QUOTE_NOT_IN_CHUNK). The 40-char floor keeps quotes distinctive enough that the sweep harness's text-quote match isn't ambiguous.

answer_note.description: Optional free-text gist of the expected answer (eval aid; not scored).

authoring.description: Provenance of this question. Seed questions are method:manual, status:seed, reviewed_by:PENDING_REVIEW until operator review backfills the reviewer and the set freezes.

method.description: How the question was authored. manual: hand-authored from chunk text by the executor. llm_assisted: drafted with LLM help (still operator-reviewed before freeze).

author.description: @handle or tool id of the author.

reviewed_by.description: @handle of the reviewer, or PENDING_REVIEW for un-reviewed seed/draft questions.

status.description: Authoring lifecycle. seed: deterministic executor-authored starter. draft: in-progress. reviewed: operator-approved (freeze prerequisite).
